title: 11:2 the spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him. According to D&C 113:1-2, Christ is the recipient of this great blessing. The Spirit of the Lord is connected to the anointing of kings (1 1 Sam. 16:13; 2 Sam. 23:2-3), including the Messiah (42:1; 59:21; 61:1). The Spirit of the Lord magnifies persons for special tasks (63:10-11; Ex. 31:2-3; Num. 11:17; 27:18; Judg. 6:34; 1 Sam. 16:13).
author: Tina M. Peterson
